basic_profile.bio: Avid anime enthusiast with a keen interest in the Naruto universe. Fresh into the Reddit community, exploring various topics from anime debates to simple living tips. Based in San Francisco, I work as a junior graphic designer by day and dive into the world of anime and manga by night. Currently single and enjoying the freedom to explore my hobbies. Typically online during late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Grew up watching Naruto and other popular anime series. Self-taught through countless hours of watching, reading manga, and participating in online forums and discussions. Recently started watching Boruto, which has reignited my interest in debates about character power levels.
